protocol.random_null: within each layer, exact empirical |w| and phase marginals independently permuted
protocol.K_convention: K_forward=g_n^dagger g_n+1; reported K_drive=conj(K_forward), matching the repo's positive B-block RoutePC drive under conj(w) deployment
protocol.exact_scope: lag-one cross-correlation identity only for complex B blocks; raw_aB is diagnostic only

stopping_decision.M1_rule: both learned-minus-null medians <0 and learned beats each within-snapshot null median on >=11/15 seeds
stopping_decision.M4_rule: >=2/3 lower B-block online correct-minus-shuffle medians positive, median lower-online specificity exceeds both lower-exact and top-online specificity
stopping_decision.next_action: STOP: report null controls; do not escalate to a multi-step diagnostic or algorithm variant
